```{=html}
<style>
.w055 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w055 .w055-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w055 .w055-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 8px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w055 .w055-row.w055-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w055 .w055-row.w055-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w055 .w055-txt { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w055 .w055-tf { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.w055 .w055-tf button {
  padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
}
.w055 .w055-tf button.w055-on { background: #d81e2e; border-color: #d81e2e; color: #fff; }
.w055 .w055-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w055 .w055-controls > button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w055 .w055-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w055 .w055-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w055 .w055-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w055 .w055-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w055 .w055-expl { font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32; padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
</style>
<div class="w055 iw" id="w055">
  <div class="w055-list" aria-label="statements to judge"></div>
  <div class="w055-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w055-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w055-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w055-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w055-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w055-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w055-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    In an autoscaling group addresses and names are handed out and taken back all the time, so an agent must not depend on a fixed IP: a new instance registers itself and its log entries carry the workload&rsquo;s identity. Because closed internal networks defeat network scanning, the Guidance recommends checking images at build time, and the thinner container wall calls for minimal images, least privilege (not running as root) and a patched runtime &mdash; see <a href="#sec-05-securing-moving-workloads">the section on securing workloads in a moving environment</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w055');
  const list = root.querySelector('.w055-list');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w055-msg');
  const expl = root.querySelector('.w055-expl');
  const ITEMS = [
    ['In an autoscaling group, a monitoring agent may safely identify a workload by its fixed IP address.', 'f'],
    ['A new instance registers itself with the monitoring system when it starts, and its log entries carry the identity of the workload.', 't'],
    ['Network-based vulnerability scanning often fails because internal networks are closed by default and each security group admits only the connections its workload needs.', 't'],
    ['The Guidance recommends checking each VM or container image at build time, so that only images known to be good ever run.', 't'],
    ['Containers should run as root, so that the runtime has all the privileges it might need.', 'f'],
    ['A large, full-featured container image is preferable to a minimal one, because it gives defenders more tools inside.', 'f']
  ];

  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w055-row').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('w055-right', 'w055-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w055-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function select(row, val) {
    row.dataset.sel = val;
    [...row.querySelectorAll('.w055-tf button')].forEach(b => {
      b.classList.toggle('w055-on', b.dataset.val === val);
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', b.dataset.val === val ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
  }
  ITEMS.forEach((it, i) => {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w055-row';
    row.dataset.a = it[1];
    row.dataset.sel = '';
    const txt = document.createElement('span');
    txt.className = 'w055-txt';
    txt.textContent = it[0];
    const tf = document.createElement('span');
    tf.className = 'w055-tf';
    [['t', 'True'], ['f', 'False']].forEach(v => {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button';
      b.dataset.val = v[0];
      b.textContent = v[1];
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        select(row, row.dataset.sel === v[0] ? '' : v[0]);
        clearMarks();
      });
      tf.appendChild(b);
    });
    row.appendChild(txt); row.appendChild(tf);
    list.appendChild(row);
  });
  root.querySelector('.w055-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, unanswered = 0;
    root.querySelectorAll('.w055-row').forEach(r => {
      r.classList.remove('w055-right', 'w055-wrong');
      if (!r.dataset.sel) { unanswered++; return; }
      if (r.dataset.sel === r.dataset.a) { r.classList.add('w055-right'); right++; }
      else r.classList.add('w055-wrong');
    });
    if (right === ITEMS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — traditional controls adjusted for a moving environment.'; msg.className = 'w055-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (unanswered > 0 && right + unanswered === ITEMS.length) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + unanswered + ' statement(s) still unanswered.'; msg.className = 'w055-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — ' + right + ' of ' + ITEMS.length + ' statements are right; rethink the red ones.'; msg.className = 'w055-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w055-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w055-row').forEach(r => select(r, ''));
    clearMarks();
    expl.hidden = true;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w055-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w055-row').forEach(r => {
      select(r, r.dataset.a);
      r.classList.remove('w055-wrong'); r.classList.add('w055-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w055-msg iw-msg ok';
    expl.hidden = false;
  });
})();
</script>
```
